mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where hope, resilience, and community come together in the most unexpected of places. Imagine a town where, in the shadow of the Civil War, people chose to reach across divides and build something truly different. That’s the heart of Covert, Michigan—a place brought to life by Anna-Lisa Cox in her book, A Stronger Kinship. Here, Black and white families didn’t just coexist; they built their lives side by side, challenging the notion that segregation was unavoidable. What if a community could stand as a living example of unity, even when the world around it seemed determined to pull people apart? Through stories of farmers, teachers, preachers, and children, we’ll explore how faith, courage, and a shared vision helped shape a society rooted in justice and compassion. As we move through the decades with Covert’s residents, we’ll discover how ordinary people—just like you and me—can make an extraordinary difference when they choose kinship over division. So, let’s explore together the inspiring legacy of Covert, where the bonds of community became stronger than the forces that tried to break them. Here’s to discovering what’s possible when we believe in each other.
